audit: THE VIEWER — top-to-bottom audit + mutation testing
method: static bug-class sweep across engine/*.py + tests, automated token-level mutation testing (engine/tests/mutate.py), self-contained suites run in isolation (test_patterns 9/9, test_features 21/21, test_routes 34/34, test_procedure 22/22).

findings.title: Preflight hang on startup (full PRAGMA quick_check on 3.65 GB index)
findings.cause: index check verified every page of the index; instant when small, minutes once OCR filled it to 3.65 GB.
findings.fix: fast _index_probe by default; auto-skip full scan above VIEWER_LARGE_DB_MB (512); --deep is time-budgeted via set_progress_handler so it cannot hang.
findings.verified: fast/large-skip/corrupt-FAIL and timeout->WARN paths tested on fixtures.

findings.title: /api/threed_refs returns 500 for any valid NSN
findings.cause: _collections_defs moved to collections_feature.py in v0.70 modularization but was never re-imported into viewer_app; NameError at request time -> 500.

findings.title: procedure_feature.py infinite loop (i -= 1 on tools-header line)
findings.cause: a SIGKILL of the OLD mutation runner (restore only in finally, skipped on hard kill) left a one-token mutant on disk.
findings.fix: restored i += 1; added test_procedure.py (parser had no test); hardened mutate.py to restore after every run + .orig sidecar + SHA verify.

findings.title: Connection leak in procedure_full
findings.cause: core.db() opened, never closed (1 open / 0 close).

findings.title: Connection leak in threed_refs (both return paths)
findings.cause: db() not closed on early-return or normal-return.

findings.title: safeguard.py runs full PRAGMA quick_check
findings.risk: same hang-class as V-01 if invoked on the 3.65 GB live index during verify/mirror.
findings.recommendation: apply the same fast-probe + size-guard + --deep budget used in preflight, or only quick_check files below a size threshold.

findings.title: Low mutation kill rate on procedure_feature.py (20%)
findings.risk: parser behavior is under-pinned by tests; refactors could silently change output.
findings.recommendation: add a DB-backed test for procedure_full; assert caps ([:24]/[:12]/[:120]/[:400]) and step-continuation/enrichment so boundary mutants are killed.

findings.title: Sandbox 9p mount tears reads/writes of host files
findings.risk: in-sandbox cp/run of host files can read a torn copy; writing through the mount during mutation could corrupt a real file (this is exactly how V-03 occurred).
findings.recommendation: always run mutation/tests on a sandbox-local copy or host-side; verify host files via the Read/Grep tools + RUN-ALL-TESTS.bat, never via raw mount reads of large files.

findings.title: No bare 'except:' and no leftover manual-counter decrements in shipped code
findings.note: sweep clean after fixes; broad 'except Exception' blocks exist but are intentional fail-open guards (documented).

mutation.note: most survivors in procedure_full (needs DB-backed test) + caps/continuation boundaries
